entities.summary: Saʽid Qomi was an Iranian Shia philosopher closely associated with the Qom School. His father, a scholar, imparted knowledge in medicine and philosophy to him. Notably, Qazi criticized the theory of substantial motion, often attributed to Mulla Sadra. Qazi Sa’id Qumi was a philosophers & thinkers from Qom (1640, Qom–1692). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
